desc:
MADE WITH FRUITS AND VEGGIES: Made with ¼ cup fruit and veggies per serving; Made with fruit puree and vegetable powder, see full ingredients list - not intended to replace fruit or vegetables in the diet; A delicious breakfast addition or snack

PACKED WITH GOODNESS: Every serving is a good source of calcium and excellent source of iron; Contains 12 vitamins and minerals, plus 14g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily)

GLUTEN FREE: A gluten free cereal with no artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources

WHOLESOME SNACKS: Enjoy a bowl of cold cereal with milk, pack as crispy school snacks, or add to homemade snack mix or cereal bars; An ideal pantry staple

CONTAINS: One 10.6 oz cereal box of Cheerios Veggie Blends Apple Strawberry flavored with other natural flavors
features:
Key Features:

Real Fruits & Vegetables

Includes apple puree and strawberry puree, along with vegetable powders like spinach, carrot, and sweet potato—each serving contains about ¼ cup of fruits and veggies.

Whole Grain Oats

Delivers 14 grams of whole grains per serving, helping support heart and digestive health.

Gluten-Free

Made without gluten, ideal for people with gluten sensitivities.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Clean label ingredients make it a better choice for families.

Fortified with 12 Vitamins & Minerals

A good source of calcium and an excellent source of iron, plus essential nutrients like Vitamin D and B vitamins.

Kid-Friendly Format

Crunchy O’s with apple-strawberry flavor make it fun and easy for kids to enjoy.

Benefits:

Supports Balanced Nutrition

Helps meet daily vitamin and mineral needs, especially iron and calcium.

Encourages Produce Intake

A practical way to include more fruits and vegetables, especially for picky eaters.

Versatile Use

Enjoyed as a breakfast cereal, snack, or as a topping on yogurt or smoothie bowls.

Health-Conscious Choice

A better-for-you cereal that fits into a balanced lifestyle, without artificial ingredients.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Meal, Sugar, Sweet Potato Powder, Corn Starch, Carrot Powder, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Strawberry Puree, Apple Puree, Corn Syrup, Salt, Spinach Powder, Color (fruit and vegetable juice, annatto extract), Tripotassium Phosphate, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
